prompt: I'm trying to decide between aspirin and acetaminophen for a lead optimization project. Can you analyze both and tell me which has better drug-likeness properties?

assertions.name: analyzes_both_molecules
assertions.check: Output analyzes both aspirin AND acetaminophen

assertions.name: includes_comparison_table
assertions.check: Output presents side-by-side comparison of both molecules

assertions.name: includes_qed_for_both
assertions.check: Output contains QED scores for both molecules

assertions.name: includes_sa_for_both
assertions.check: Output contains SA scores for both molecules

assertions.name: provides_recommendation
assertions.check: Output clearly recommends which molecule is better for lead optimization

assertions.name: explains_reasoning
assertions.check: Output explains WHY one molecule is recommended over the other
